newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 13.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prosecutors question three professional baseball players over allegations that they purposely threw games in exchange for cash payments from people running gambling rackets.
Board of Foreign Trade starts issuing import permits for 7,700 Japanese sedans.
Three professional baseball stars detained over cheating allegations.
The Dalai Lama praises Taiwan's democratic development.
U.S. dollar remains strong in international market.
Taiwan to allow import of Vietnamese workers.
Liton Electronics group plans to purcase the semi-conductor department of the General Instrument, Taiwan unit.
Foreign funds continue to pour into Taiwan's bourse; net inflow amounted to US$337 million from January 1 to February 5.
